title: The Little Mermaid (The Crown of the Daughters of the Air)
summary: Gazing upon the prince sleeping beside his bride, the little mermaid cast the witch's dagger into the foaming sea and surrendered her life to the ocean waves....
full_text:
Gazing upon the prince sleeping beside his bride, the little mermaid cast the witch's dagger into the foaming sea and surrendered her life to the ocean waves.

Lifted into the radiant fellowship of the Daughters of the Air, she was blessed with the holy task of bringing coolness to burning deserts and comfort to suffering children, walking the golden path to the eternal kingdom of God.
moral: Love that surrenders itself without bitter possessiveness receives the crown of an immortal soul.
